predicate_verbalization.case: case(arg0, arg1, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5, arg6, arg7)

rule_verbalization.1: If case(arg0, arg1, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5, arg6, arg7) and casedet(arg8, arg9, arg10) hold and arg8 = arg1, then t(arg0, arg1, arg8, arg10) holds.

rule_verbalization.3: If t(arg0, arg1, arg2, arg3) and t(arg4, arg5, arg1, arg6) hold, then cites(arg4, arg0) holds.
rule_verbalization.4: If mayCite(arg0, arg1) and cites(arg1, arg2) hold, then shouldCite(arg0, arg2) holds.
rule_verbalization.5: If shouldCite(arg0, arg1) and cites(arg1, arg2) hold, then shouldCite(arg0, arg2) holds.
rule_verbalization.Q: If shouldCite(arg0, arg1) and case(arg1, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5, arg6, arg7, arg8) hold and arg8 = "convicted", then relevantCase(arg0, arg1, arg2) holds.
